variantPolicy: Seeded variants alter denominator, workload, telemetry freshness, and business ambiguity; variants are replay aids and not independent published assets.

exercises.title: Write an Actionable Checkout Alert Contract
exercises.objective: Create a customer-impact alert with evidence, ownership, and safe closure.
exercises.initialState: Synthetic checkout success, latency, traffic, pool, dependency, deployment, and payment fixtures are available.
exercises.prompt: Define signal, denominator, windows, corroboration, severity, deduplication, maintenance, evidence package, runbook, escalation, and resolution.
exercises.deliverable: Versioned alert contract and test matrix.

hints.text: Page on impact and diagnose with context.
Define what happens when the provider is stale.

exercises.referenceSolution: Use a business success signal and valid denominator with workload-aware windows, resource/dependency context, named owner/severity/runbook, bounded privacy-safe incident key, explicit maintenance expiry, telemetry-degraded behavior, and separate technical/business recovery checks.

exercises.title: Lead an Alert-Fatigue Review
exercises.objective: Turn noisy or late alerts into measured reliability improvements.
exercises.initialState: Synthetic history shows duplicate pages, false positives during maintenance, one late checkout impact, and missing business context.
exercises.prompt: Analyze detection and response quality, propose policy changes, define tests and owners, and preserve residual risk.
exercises.deliverable: Alert review, corrective-action portfolio, and evidence plan.

hints.text: Separate detection failure from response toil.
Measure whether a new rule improves decisions.

exercises.referenceSolution: Classify noise and missed impact, add business SLIs and corroborating context, correct deduplication and maintenance expiry, test provider and runbook behavior, assign measurable owners, and retain residual risk.

exercises.title: Fault-Inject Alert Delivery and Closure
exercises.objective: Verify alert safety when signals, delivery, and business state disagree.
exercises.initialState: A deterministic alert engine receives normal, impact, telemetry-loss, duplicate, deployment, and ambiguous-payment fixtures.
exercises.prompt: Define fault injections, expected alert states, evidence retention, routing fallback, resolution checks, and runtime execution boundary.

hints.text: Test alert lifecycle, not only trigger.
Resolution needs business evidence for ambiguous outcomes.

exercises.referenceSolution: Inject impact and non-impact fixtures, require visible degraded telemetry, group only the same incident, test maintenance expiry and alternate delivery, block closure on ambiguous business state, and verify privacy and target-provider boundaries.
